title: [SOFTWARE FIXTURE ONLY] Final 10K execution
notes: Representative execution fixture, not an admitted programme or D8 approval. General draft; primary EASY work uses confirmed Zone 2. Quality requires explicit M2.3 selection/review/acceptance. No automatic fallback. Flat measured course or track preferred. Record elapsed time, exact distance, route/surface, weather, splits, RPE and environment. Disable auto-pause. First 2 km controlled; km 3–7 even sustainable effort; assess at 7 km and increase only if able; commit in final kilometre. Use training evidence to select pace. If unwell/in pain, do not force the assessment; retain an unavailable result and review timing.
